arguments.content: The privilege log for matter MAT-2026-0124 contains overlapping bates ranges from a prior production, creating substantial risk of inadvertent waiver of attorney-client privilege. Pursuant to Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(c), Defendant Apex Global Solutions LLC respectfully requests a protective order to address the erroneous production and prevent waiver. This motion is supported by controlling precedent including *In re Teleglobe Communications Corp.*, 493 F.3d 345 (3d Cir. 2007), which establishes that inadvertent disclosure does not automatically waive privilege when reasonable steps were taken to prevent disclosure and to rectify the error promptly. The overlap was identified internally during quality review, and this filing constitutes prompt remedial action. Proposed corrective measures include retrieval of the overproduced documents, amendment of the privilege log, and submission of a corrected log to the Court and opposing counsel under separate cover.
